extracted.name: Chickpea Salad
extracted.description: This easy chickpea salad recipe is satisfying and delicious. Filled with protein-packed garbanzo beans, fresh vegetables, and a zesty lemon dressing, it's a perfect picnic side dish or healthy lunch.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups mixed yellow and red grape tomatoes (halved)
½ cup kalamata olives (pitted and halved)
¼ cup chopped fresh mint (plus whole mint leaves for garnish)
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, mustard, salt, and several grinds of pepper.
Add the chickpeas, tomatoes, cucumber, pickled onions, and olives and toss to coat. Add the parsley, dill, and mint and toss again.
Season to taste, garnish with fresh mint leaves, and serve.
